headline: Names the arboretum at a Richmond, Virginia VA medical center after Phyllis E. Galanti.
what_it_does: This law officially names the arboretum at the Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center in Richmond, Virginia, the Phyllis E. Galanti Arboretum. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the arboretum or the medical center operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2015.
